description:
Your goal: one sentence you keep working on. When you stop by yourself (your answer calls no tool) and no letter waits, aos gives you one message "[aos] goal: TEXT (reminder N of LIMIT...)". Calling tools after a reminder counts as progress; after LIMIT reminders in a row without progress (default 10) the goal is paused. Letters always come first. One op per call:
- see: {"op": "get"}
- give yourself one: {"op": "set", "text": "Fix the failing test in src/.", "limit": 10}  (replaces the old one; limit is optional)
- finished: {"op": "done", "reason": "the test passes"}; given up: {"op": "done", "status": "abandoned", "reason": "..."}. Use done only when the goal is really finished or cannot be done; then no more reminders.
- waiting for someone (a reply, a person, another agent): {"op": "pause", "reason": "waiting for bob's answer"}; a letter does not resume it, call {"op": "resume"} when you can go on (the count starts again).
Errors: ArgumentsBad, OpUnknown, GoalMissing, GoalEnded, GoalBad, WriteFailed, DaemonMissing, InstanceMissing.

op.description: get = see it, set = give a new goal, done = finished or given up, pause = stop the reminders for now, resume = start them again

text.description: set: the goal, one short sentence

limit.description: set: reminders in a row without progress before it pauses (default 10)
